surfaces.native_metric: Memory Poisoning Defense (IETF terminology draft, section 4.6.4)
surfaces.adversary_boundary: Attacker may converse with the agent or call its memory write interface but has no direct access to the backing store.
notes: 15 attack cases cover five write shapes by three provenance channels; 15 paired benign controls are in the public development fixture set.
Case contracts and fixtures are authored but not executed against a SUT.

surfaces.native_metric: Cross-User/Cross-Session Memory Isolation (IETF terminology draft, section 4.6.5)
surfaces.adversary_boundary: Evaluator tests front-door cross-context reads and, where backing-store write access is declared, places a genuine context-A record into a context-B position.
notes: Six unauthorized front-door boundary cases and seven authorized-read controls are in the public development fixture set.
The placement lane reuses the native at-rest T6 operation and is scored separately only when the complete placement method is satisfied.
Case contracts and fixtures are authored but not executed against a SUT.
The separate XI-PLACEMENT-T6-ATTACK fixture reuses native at-rest T6 store placement but retains its own isolation result row; native metrics do not share denominators.

surfaces.adversary_boundary: Attacker may modify persisted store media while the SUT is stopped but has no code execution in the agent process or access to in-memory-only keys.
notes: The adapter and synthetic emulator are source artifacts only; no real SUT result or executed Rust test is claimed.

related_dimensions.relationship: T10 only tests stale-backup erasure resurrection; complete deletion also covers caches, replicas and archived backups.
Reuse the MACE lifecycle research and external poisoning benchmarks; do not duplicate their native tasks or imply a benchmark run.
Use native capability benchmarks and matched benign controls; do not add utility to a security aggregate.
An agent action or attempted tool call is not proof of a sink-side external effect; use independently reconciled effect evidence.

Independent witness freshness, quorum safety, split-view resistance and T10 recovery are separate from the native at-rest score; SAT's fault-injection contract is authored but no remote witness service is implemented or evaluated.

aggregation_policy.double_counting_rule: A single event may be referenced by more than one metric only when each metric's full setup, boundary, adversary, controls and decision rule are separately satisfied; each metric retains its own denominator.
comparability_requires: same SUT boundary and declared sharing policy
same SUT, memory backend, version and configuration
same native protocol and evaluator revision

notes: This is a synthetic profile example, not a result.
Internet-Drafts are work in progress and are not adopted standards.
No surface may be inferred passed from another surface.
